query: 减排目标 减排目标 衡量企业温室气体减排目标的科学性、完整性与可执行性。 内容质量得分 - 2分：有明确阶段性目标（>=2)，并体现“减排”的定量内容（或者scope1、2内容），如综合能源消耗的减少或者温室气体排放量的减少。 - 1分：只有减排的定量内容，或者只有一个阶段的目标。 - 0分：不满足任意一点/无披露。 减排目标 碳减排目标 温室气体减排目标 排放强度目标 绝对减排 强度减排 基准年 目标年 中期目标 阶段性目标 分阶段目标 范围一和范围二目标 科学碳目标 SBTi emission reduction target carbon reduction target GHG reduction target emissions intensity target absolute reduction target baseline year target year interim target near-term target phased target Scope 1 and 2 target science-based target SBTi 企业是否披露明确的温室气体减排目标？ 目标值、基准年和目标年分别是什么？ 是否存在两个及以上阶段性目标？ 目标覆盖Scope 1、Scope 2还是Scope 3？ 目标对象是绝对排放、排放强度还是综合能耗？

Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露明确的温室气体减排目标？ 目标值、基准年和目标年分别是什么？ 是否存在两个及以上阶段性目标？ 目标覆盖Scope 1、Scope 2还是Scope 3？ 目标对象是绝对排放、排放强度还是综合能耗？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有历史排放下降而无未来目标；仅有净零口号而无定量减排目标；仅有减排措施描述而无目标数值；仅有能源节约倡议而无量化目标；区分：减排目标要求具体减排幅度与时间节点；净零/碳中和承诺强调长期终点与抵消规则；减排措施和规划强调已实施行动或路径，不能仅凭措施存在推定已有定量目标。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Risk Management: How to Identify and Manage Climate-related Risks
results.text: For the first time, the Group reported climate-related financial disclosures with reference to TCFD recommendations in order to enhance the transparency of ESG reporting. Meanwhile during the Year, the Group formulated a medium and long-term plan for green development, energy use efficiency objectives, waste reduction objectives, emission objectives and water use efficiency objectives, and defined specific measures to achieve the plans and objectives. In addition, the Group continued to disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions data, while focusing on the statistics and management of Scope 3 GHG emissions. The Group also promoted the use of public transport as a priority in the Travel Management System and continued to promote the use of teleconferencing systems to reduce indirect GHG emissions associated with travel.

Risk Management: How to Identify and Manage Climate-related Risks

[Content]
For the first time, the Group reported climate-related financial disclosures with reference to TCFD recommendations in order to enhance the transparency of ESG reporting. Meanwhile during the Year, the Group formulated a medium and long-term plan for green development, energy use efficiency objectives, waste reduction objectives, emission objectives and water use efficiency objectives, and defined specific measures to achieve the plans and objectives. In addition, the Group continued to disclose Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions data, while focusing on the statistics and management of Scope 3 GHG emissions. The Group also promoted the use of public transport as a priority in the Travel Management System and continued to promote the use of teleconferencing systems to reduce indirect GHG emissions associated with travel.

In the future, we will pay more attention to product quality, improve ESG management, promote business diversification, continue to bring sustainable development value to employees, customers and investors, and work together to build a better social vision.

results.section: Case: Data Disaster Recovery Drill
results.text: In September 2021, in order to test the results of the information system emergency response plan, the Group held an information security emergency drill at Agile Centre. The drill was divided into four stages: determination of drill target and form, plan preparation, drill implementation, and drill summary and evaluation. By locating and analysing system servers and terminals, disconnecting and isolating the network, confirming the scope of infection, arranging backup and recovery and other measures, the Group effectively curbed the spread of risks and resumed business operations at the fastest speed, and ultimately achieved the expected results, enhancing the Group's ability to quickly recover its business systems and to respond to risks under extreme circumstance.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Case: Data Disaster Recovery Drill

[Content]
In September 2021, in order to test the results of the information system emergency response plan, the Group held an information security emergency drill at Agile Centre. The drill was divided into four stages: determination of drill target and form, plan preparation, drill implementation, and drill summary and evaluation. By locating and analysing system servers and terminals, disconnecting and isolating the network, confirming the scope of infection, arranging backup and recovery and other measures, the Group effectively curbed the spread of risks and resumed business operations at the fastest speed, and ultimately achieved the expected results, enhancing the Group's ability to quickly recover its business systems and to respond to risks under extreme circumstance.
